is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on the sand fly Phlebotomus papatasi: 'Acetylcholinesterase of the sand fly, Phlebotomus papatasi (Scopoli): construction, expression and biochemical properties of the G119S orthologous mutant' (page 1).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study examines the G119S orthologous site in recombinant sand fly AChE1 (PpAChE1), not Anopheles target markers.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No genotype data or allele frequencies for Anopheles populations are reported.

african_field_population.evidence: No African field populations of mosquitoes were used. The study used a laboratory colony of Phlebotomus papatasi maintained in Kerrville, Texas (page 2).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary research article investigating recombinant sand fly AChE1 expression and enzyme inhibition kinetics.

duplicate_risk.evidence: Not applicable; not an Anopheles study.

supplement.evidence: No supplementary data needed; the paper is entirely out of scope.

assessment.summary: This paper investigates the biochemical properties and inhibition kinetics of the G119S orthologous mutant of acetylcholinesterase-1 in the sand fly Phlebotomus papatasi using recombinant baculoviral expression and a laboratory colony. No Anopheles mosquitoes were studied.
exclusion_reasons: Not an Anopheles study (focuses on the sand fly Phlebotomus papatasi)
Does not report target resistance markers in Anopheles
Does not study African field populations
